_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'SCHEDULE MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.03.01.

f01_Scheduling_Methodology_Selection.label: Scheduling Methodology Selection
f01_Scheduling_Methodology_Selection.guidance: The scheduling framework applied (e.g., Critical Path Method, Agile cadence, or Critical Chain).

f02_Scheduling_Software_and_Systems.label: Scheduling Software and Systems
f02_Scheduling_Software_and_Systems.guidance: Approved project management and scheduling software tools used to build and maintain the schedule model.

f03_Rolling_Wave_Planning_Approach.section: Planning Cadence and Level of Detail
f03_Rolling_Wave_Planning_Approach.label: Rolling Wave Planning Approach
f03_Rolling_Wave_Planning_Approach.guidance: Level of detail and decomposition horizon applied to near-term vs. long-term project activities.

f04_Agile_Timeboxing_and_Iteration_Rules.section: Planning Cadence and Level of Detail
f04_Agile_Timeboxing_and_Iteration_Rules.label: Agile Timeboxing and Iteration Rules
f04_Agile_Timeboxing_and_Iteration_Rules.guidance: Standard sprint lengths, release cadence, and timeboxing rules for iterative work packages.

f05_Units_of_Measure_for_Durations.section: Units of Measure and Estimation Accuracy
f05_Units_of_Measure_for_Durations.label: Units of Measure for Durations
f05_Units_of_Measure_for_Durations.guidance: Designated units of measure (hours, days, weeks) applied across schedule estimates.

f06_Level_of_Accuracy_and_Estimating_Ran.section: Units of Measure and Estimation Accuracy
f06_Level_of_Accuracy_and_Estimating_Ran.label: Level of Accuracy and Estimating Ranges
f06_Level_of_Accuracy_and_Estimating_Ran.guidance: Acceptable variance ranges (+/- percentage) required for duration and effort estimates.

f07_Earned_Value_Management_EVM_Rules.label: Earned Value Management (EVM) Rules
f07_Earned_Value_Management_EVM_Rules.guidance: Techniques used for measuring physical progress and establishing percent complete (e.g., 50/50, 0/100, milestone weights).

f08_Schedule_Performance_Indicators.label: Schedule Performance Indicators
f08_Schedule_Performance_Indicators.guidance: Key metrics tracked including SV, SPI, critical path float, and milestone variance.

f09_Schedule_Variance_Thresholds.label: Schedule Variance Thresholds
f09_Schedule_Variance_Thresholds.guidance: Permissible delay thresholds that trigger mandatory corrective actions and executive escalations.

f10_Schedule_Update_and_Baselines_Protoc.label: Schedule Update and Baselines Protocol
f10_Schedule_Update_and_Baselines_Protoc.guidance: Cadence for schedule status updates, critical path recalculation, and baseline change governance.
